newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra shares rise on '96 profit lift.
newsitem.headline: Astra shares rise on '96 profit lift.

text.p: Shares in major Swedish drugs company Astra AB rose on Wednesday after the company published its 1996 earnings.
Immediately after the report was released Astra shares rose four crowns to 366 crowns.
Astra posted a 10 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 13.22 billion crowns. The market had expected Astra to report a nine percent rise in profits to 13.17 billion crowns.
"It was a good report, in line with expectations," said analyst Goran Kallebo from Matteus.
"Astra's own Losec sales were excellent. Only the pain control area was a little lower than expected."
